candidate_spec.high_level_variant: Ego starts slightly offset in lane and approaches a damp, puddled section near a slow walker on the roadside, progresses very slowly without stopping completely, and times out with a goal deviation while oracle does not flag stuck or lane_invasion despite possible minor lane offset.
candidate_spec.mutation_intent: Bias the ego spawn and environment so that planning keeps issuing waypoints around wet patches and a nearby walker, leading to cautious low-speed motion and failure to finish the route in time. This sustains active perception/planning and low-speed movement while preserving uncertainty about stuck and lane invasion, matching the label-oracle mismatch pattern.
pre_execution_validation_rules: Ensure the new ego spawn offset places the vehicle near, but not overlapping with, the first puddle and still within a valid lane.
Verify that the walker remains on or near a sidewalk/roadside such that it is detectable but not immediately blocking the lane.
Confirm that the reduced speed for the lead vehicle still allows it to remain ahead of ego for a significant duration, promoting cautious, low-speed following behavior.
Check that increased rain and wetness values stay within simulator stability limits and do not cause extreme visibility loss that would contradict the active perception constraint.
post_execution_validation_rules: Verify that error_json again reports a goal-related failure without collision, stuck, lane_invasion, red_light, or speeding events.
Confirm that at least one perceived object (vehicle or walker) is continuously present in perception/prediction topics throughout the critical window.
Confirm that final_waypoints remain continuously available and nonempty until scenario termination.
Analyze ego trajectory to ensure predominantly low-speed motion with no long-duration complete standstill and without prolonged high-speed sections.
Check whether higher-level annotations or dataset outputs classify the run as stuck or lane_invasion, documenting any discrepancy between these labels and error_json.
Ensure that, even if ego crosses lane markings due to puddle avoidance or offset spawn, no explicit lane_invasion oracle event is produced; otherwise, the run does not match this pattern.
uncertainty: Whether the ego will exhibit minor lane departures around puddles without triggering a formal lane_invasion event is inherently uncertain.
The degree to which damp-road behavior slows the ego enough to cause a goal-deviation timeout is uncertain and must be observed empirically.
Internal control command patterns may differ from the seed case; their relationship to observed ego motion remains unresolved and is not enforced.

note: Generated candidate scenario JSON for local DriveFuzz execution. It has not been executed in CARLA/Autoware.
